local_dishes.name: Kerala Sadya
local_dishes.description: Quintessential Kerala meal - lavish spread of vegetarian dishes served on banana leaf including rice, various curries, pickles, and desserts

local_dishes.name: Appam and Stew
local_dishes.description: Rice pancake with soft, spongy centre and crispy edges, perfect for dipping in mild coconut stew

local_dishes.name: Puttu and Kadala Curry
local_dishes.description: Steamed rice cylinders served with spicy black chickpea curry - popular breakfast item

local_dishes.name: Banana Chips
local_dishes.description: Crispy and slightly sweet banana chips - popular snack

local_dishes.name: Thalassery Biryani
local_dishes.description: Popular variant of biryani known for fragrant rice and rich, flavourful spices

local_dishes.name: Ghee Roast Dosa
local_dishes.description: Crispy and buttery dosa with rich ghee flavour, served with coconut chutney and sambar

local_dishes.name: Bonda
local_dishes.description: Deep-fried snacks with crispy outer layer and soft, spicy filling - popular tea-time treat

local_dishes.name: Kozhikodan Halwa
local_dishes.description: Sweet treat made from wheat flavoured with ghee and cardamom

local_dishes.name: Payasam
local_dishes.description: Delicious rice or vermicelli pudding flavoured with cardamom and garnished with cashews and raisins

local_dishes.name: Kattan Chaya
local_dishes.description: Strong black tea - local specialty

local_dishes.name: Pazham Pori (Kerala Banana Fritters)
local_dishes.description: Crispy golden banana fritters made using ripe bananas coated in a light batter. Perfect as an evening snack with tea.

local_dishes.name: Parippu Vada
local_dishes.description: A crunchy lentil fritter with spices and curry leaves, commonly enjoyed with chai across Kerala.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Tea stalls and local eateries across Kerala

local_dishes.name: Kerala Sweet Corn & Spiced Pineapple
local_dishes.description: Fresh sweet corn and pineapple slices sprinkled with local spices, often available at scenic viewpoints and roadside stalls.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Appam with Stew
local_dishes.description: Soft lace-edged rice pancakes served with creamy coconut stew. Mild, comforting and one of Kerala's signature breakfast and dinner dishes. Vegetarian and chicken options available.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Hotels and local restaurants across Kerala
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kerala Sadya (Traditional Kerala Meal)
local_dishes.description: A complete Kerala feast traditionally served on a banana leaf featuring rice, curries, pickles, avial, sambar, pachadi and desserts.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kerala Chicken Roast with Malabar Parotta
local_dishes.description: Slow-cooked chicken in roasted spices paired with flaky layered parotta. One of Kerala's most loved dishes.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Karimeen Pollichathu (Pearl Spot Fish)
local_dishes.description: Fresh fish marinated with spices, wrapped in banana leaf and grilled slowly for rich flavours.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kerala Prawn Curry
local_dishes.description: A coconut-based seafood curry with traditional spices and a slightly tangy flavour profile.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Kerala Filter Coffee
local_dishes.description: Freshly brewed strong coffee with a rich aroma, perfect during cool Munnar mornings.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Sri Mu Saravana Bhavan and local cafés across Kerala
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Tender Coconut Water
local_dishes.description: Naturally refreshing and ideal for staying hydrated during sightseeing.

local_dishes.name: Palada Payasam
local_dishes.description: Kerala's famous dessert made using milk, rice flakes and slow-cooked sweetness, commonly served during celebrations and festive meals.

safety_tips.tip: Keep your phone charged before long sightseeing days and share your live location with family if preferred.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Keep hotel addresses and driver's contact details accessible at all times.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Carry bottled water during sightseeing and stay hydrated, especially during city exploration in Cochin.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Avoid carrying large amounts of cash. Keep passports, IDs and valuables safely stored and use hotel safes where available.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Always ask permission before taking close-up photographs of local people, especially inside religious or cultural places.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Consider an international roaming plan or a local SIM card upon arrival
connectivity_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/All Inclusive Guide- Kerala.pdf

health_tips.tip: Carry prescription medicines and travel insurance
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/All Inclusive Guide- Kerala.pdf

health_tips.tip: Use mosquito/insect repellent due to tropical climate
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/All Inclusive Guide- Kerala.pdf

health_tips.tip: Kerala does not typically require any special or mandatory vaccinations for travellers arriving from India.
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Carry any regular prescription medicines in original packaging.
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Keep a small first-aid kit with pain relief medication, motion sickness tablets (helpful for Munnar hill roads), band-aids, antiseptic cream, medicines for acidity or stomach discomfort, and allergy medication if required.
health_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Carry any regular medications in your day bag during sightseeing and stay hydrated by carrying bottled water.
